evals.prompt: Superwhisper is installed on this Mac and its CLI is on my PATH as `superwhisper`. I moved my Superwhisper folder, it's at {SANDBOX}/superwhisper. Before any superwhisper command, export SUPERWHISPER_DB={SANDBOX}/db.sqlite and SUPERWHISPER_SETTINGS={SANDBOX}/superwhisper/settings/settings.json. Optimize my Superwhisper setup: fix the words it keeps getting wrong and build me better modes. I'm a founder, I dictate Slack messages, emails, and AI prompts all day. Don't ask me questions, use sensible defaults (build all the useful modes, match my tone from history).
evals.expected_output: Vocabulary/replacements added based on history; Write for me, Message, and Format selected text modes created as valid JSON files; existing files untouched; summary + restart reminder.

evals.prompt: superwhisper keeps butchering names when i dictate - my company superultrainc, my coworkers Austen and Neil, and product stuff like Parakeet and Cohere Transcribe come out mangled. fix my dictation vocabulary so these come out right.
